content: Anatumi Isaraele Wambu Peparae Koo Dupwa Kaepala Mona Enenge Palyuo Epena Lao Kyakale Leya
Nakama Isaraele wambu dupwa pii dake selapape. Wambu malu pinya yanyanda mareta piso ee romo lenge dokoreke doko nakamana lao leto, leya.

content.text: Isaraele doko enda mapwae akali mare kanda nange dopale kandale doko
sipurao epa nao isa pao palu palyuo palamo.
Mendeme nyuo sukusa pyambwa naminyipa isa pao palu palyuo palamo doko
mendeme baa nyiso minyalyuo nyii nara ingilyamo.

content: Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa karenge dokome pii dapa letamo leya. Isaraele wambunya yuu taone andake mendakinya yanda singi taosande mendaki (1,000) yanda pela pena lao nembaraminyi dokopa andete mendaki (100) iki anda kapu kyuo eparami. Dee taone andake mendena yanda singi andete mendaki (100) yanda pela pena lao nembaraminyi dokopa akalisa iki anda kapu kyuo eparami.
Kamongo dokome Isaraele wambu dupwa lamaiyuo, Nakama namba keta ipupwape. Epapala dokopa nakama lete kararami.

Nakama yuu Biasipa dokona kingi wapambupi lakao misi lala paa nalapape. Yuu Betele doko buru bara paramo mena wambupi mende yapo rungi nyii naraŋa dokona namba karepe lao kotala paa nalapape. Yuu Gilikale dokona nakama paa nalapape. Dokona palenge wambu dupwa yuu wakale mendena karapusi pyuo lanyuo parami ingilyamo leya.

Nakama Kamongo karara dokona papala lete karalapape. Doko kaepala paa narami ramo doko baa isare kekenge dopale ingyuo nakama Isaraele wambu dupwa keta epara. Isare dokome nakama yuu Betele wambu dupwa rao otara. Dokopa mendeme isare doko kapa kunja nara.
Akali kote pii angi lakamiramili doko kaepala kwaeyo lakamilyaminyi dupwape yulu rolae dupwa isa nembelyaminyi dupwape pyuo kokwa sinyi nembasi silyamo.

content.text: Baameko yuu iminjingi doko yangena lao
Dopako pyuo baame ipwa kota dupwa pulyuo epena lao nyepala
dee apunda ingyuo kulimbwanyi yuu dokona isa peenge.
Banya kingi doko Kamongo ingyuo palena.
Baame akali porai dupwa kokwa soo pena lao nakama kimbu isa ingyuo minyaro karelyamo poraiyuo karenge dupwa pyao lokwalyo pingi.

content: Nakama Isaraele wambu dupwame wambu nakama kyai pilyaminyi lao lao panami dupwape kotena pii rolae laminyi dupwape awa nalyaminyi.

Nakamame wambu pendewa dupwa pyalana pyuo kalyinyi palyapala nakamana nenge dupwa waa nyakamyuo karaminyi kande. Dokona lao nakamana kaname anda keyange piyaminyi dupwana pali nao nakamba range girapo ee keyange wara piyaminyi dokona ipwa waene elyape dupwa naa nao pirami, leya.

Nakamana koo wakasa pilyaminyi dupwape kendepo kendepo wakasa nao pyuo karaminyi dusipa nambame yaka lanyi pyambuo soo karo. Nakamame akali keyange dupwa randa maiyuo karaminyi. Nakamame girisi pyuo kana jimi dupwa nyepala akali pendewa dupwana kote dupwa angi mondo lao sakami nalyaminyi, leya.
Dokona kwaelyamo yuu gii dokopa elya kalo karenge doko ama mona palipala pingi.

Yulu koo dupwa yaki nyuo kaepala yulu rolae dupwana anjuku lao moko minyuo pyuo kararaminyi dokopa nakama kapa pisirami. Nakamame dokopa Kamongo Anatu Porai Wakasa doko namwa pipya karamano letaminyi doko letaminyili pyuo baa kinyi nakama piya role pyao karara.

Yulu koo dupwa epe kanda nao karapala yulu rolae dupwana mona nyuo pyuo karalapape. Nakamame kote pii dupwa rolae angi dokona palyuo lao karalapape. Dopa pyuo kararami ramo dokopa Kamongo dokome nakamana rara dokona mee kyaka petaminyi dupwa sakame kumuo karara rapisi.

Dokona lao Kamongo Anatu Porai Wakasa dokome dopa letamo. Taone andake dupwana kata dupwana kondome kumuo ee lao kumaralerale nyuo pisirami. Mena rapu pyuo ee wara pyuo pingi akali dupwa ee lala epena laraminyi opetaeko ee lakana lao kana mailyaminyi lenge dupwa piya wambu kumarami dupwana yongo dupwana lao ee larami.
Isa girapo ee dupwa peparaena ee lao kumaralerale nyuo pisirami. Doo leto dupwa piya kande doko nambame randa jerosa pira, Kamongo dokome leya.

Kamongona yuu gii doko ipyali yaka lao isilyaminyi dupwa kondo adake. Yuu gii dokome bange keyange aki mende minyakao eparase? Yuu gii dokome nakama iminjingi dokome yambe pyara. Yangaramo pisa narami.

Yuu gii dokopa akali mende mena laene kando paka pelyoŋo lapala mena beya karara dokona pao romeya dopale ingyara. Dopako pyuo akali mende anda range pao nambana anda dake dokoŋo lapala apya dokona kingi minyanyi pirasa kaumi naramo dopale ingyara.
Kamongona yuu gii doko elyape ingyuo eŋa pao gii palya nara.
Kamongo dokome pii dopa letamo. Nakamana yuu gii andake nyuo malu palyuo nenge nao misi lenge dupwa nambame kando rae maiyuo awaka nalyo.

Nakamame nenge kiso mukinyi nembo maingipi witi jingi maingipi dolapo minyuo epo jeraminyi dokopa nambame rae maiyuo ama nyii naro. Nakamame mena susu lao nenge maipala ando rondo lapyamo minyapala namba jela eparaminyi dupwa kando aiyaka lao nyii naroko.
Nakamana kenane dokome ipwa uu lele lao karaminyi doko kaeyalapape. Nakamana gita pilyamano laminyi dokopa namba soo epe nasilyo.
Doo piminyi dupwa kaepala rolenge renge doko nakama keta ipwa ingyuo lyuo karena. Dopa pipala yulu rolae dupwa nakama keta ipwa ingyuo sokwa nao guu lao karena.
Nakama Isaraele wambu dupwa ee kana akalisa kisima nenge see nange yuu muiyane dokona palyuo lanyuo epeyo dokopa nambame nakama mena yakape kiso joo bange dupwa joo pilapa lao kongo pii nayo.
Dopa piyuko doŋo epapuli nakamame kiŋi Sakutipa bui Kaewanepa dolapo anatuŋu lao isa kanapeme wasapala dolapo anatu ingyuo lakando karaminyi.

Dokona nambame nakama yuu wakale Damasakesa dumurena karapusi nembeyo kande dokopa nakamana mee bangeme anatu lao wasisi dupwa range role pyapeta soo parami. Namba Kamongo kingi Anatu Porai Wakasa dokome pii dake leto.
